## Decisions

- **v1.0.1, a patch.** Since v1.0.0, `main` has only two fixes (#89,
full-URL references in rendered files; #65, the language rule) and their
tests; `copier.yml` is unchanged, so no question or contract changed and
an update needs no new answers.
- **Released from `84179d1`, the merge of #89.** Annotated tag `v1.0.1`,
as v1.0.0 was, and the [GitHub
release](https://github.com/brunoccalmeida/automation-template/releases/tag/v1.0.1).
Its notes name both fixes and say which project-owned files `copier
update` leaves alone (`ci.yml`, `dependabot.yml`, the smoke specs) and
that the `Documentation language:` line can be added to an existing
`CLAUDE.md`.
- **Proof from GitHub, with no repository created.** Copier 9.19.1,
`copier copy --defaults --data project_name=v101-proof --data
pack=ts-playwright gh:brunoccalmeida/automation-template gen` with no
`--vcs-ref`: `.copier-answers.yml` recorded `_commit: v1.0.1`; a search
of the rendered files for a bare `#N` or `ADR NNNN` outside a URL found
none, `ci.yml` cites the ADRs by full URL, and `CLAUDE.md` has
`Documentation language: English`. No CI run of a generated project,
unlike v1.0.0: the two fixes change comments, documentation and one
rule, which `test` already renders and checks.
- **Summary:** the Situation row records the release; "Pending in the
kit" now names v1.0.1, the `Documentation language:` line and the three
project-owned files; the Release row of the plan links v1.0.1. The next
mission is unchanged: #62, then #86 from Sunday 2026-11-29 14:15 UTC.

## Sources

- Copier, [Generating a
project](https://copier.readthedocs.io/en/stable/generating/): "By
default, Copier will copy from the last release found in template Git
tags, sorted as PEP 440"; [Updating a
project](https://copier.readthedocs.io/en/stable/updating/): `copier
update` "will compare them using PEP 440, and will check out the latest
one".
- [PEP 440, "Preceding v character"](https://peps.python.org/pep-0440/):
"The same version with and without the `v` is considered equivalent", so
`v1.0.1` sorts after `v1.0.0`. Matched by the proof above.
- [Semantic Versioning 2.0.0](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html), item
6: "Patch version Z (x.y.Z | x > 0) MUST be incremented if only backward
compatible bug fixes are introduced." Applying it to a template (no
question changed = compatible) is judgment.
